title: Cohort onboarding pulse + interview debriefs (Oct 14 2025)
content:
Purpose: quick sync doc for the week — combine interview debrief snippets, cohort week-2 pulse, and follow-ups for platform-engineering. This is a working note, not final.

Context:
- We hired 3 engineers from the summer outreach program (cohort A) and onboarded 2 lateral hires in the past 6 weeks. This doc captures pairing feedback, interview debriefs for two senior candidates, and a short team-health snapshot after the cohort hack day.

Interview debriefs (short):
1) Candidate: SR Eng (backend infra) — K. Nguyen
   - Interviewers: Liam, Maya, Aisha
   - Focus: distributed caches, autoscaling, failure modes
   - Notes: strong mental model for cache sharding, asked good questions about KV cache warming and cold-starts. Whiteboard solution had edge-case for rebalancing missed; proposed locking that could become a hotspot.
   - Score (loose rubric): System design 8/10, Coding 7/10, Culture fit 8/10
   - Recommendation: proceed to take-home; ask take-home to explicitly include a rebalancing component and a small perf write-up.
   - Follow-up: assign take-home to candidate (owner: Liam, due: 2025-10-21).

2) Candidate: Mid/Senior SRE — J. Osei
   - Interviewers: Ravi, Dana
   - Focus: incident response, runbooks, on-call tradeoffs
   - Notes: concrete examples of incident jiras; emphasized observable-driven mitigation. Slightly light on infra-as-code best practices (Terraform nuance).
   - Score: Incident Mgmt 9/10, IaC 6/10, Communication 8/10
   - Recommendation: consider for SRE generalist role but pair with infra-engineer to round out IaC skills. Possible hire for rotational program.
   - Action: schedule pair session with infra lead (owner: Ravi).

Interview follow-up questions (for debrief thread):
- For K. Nguyen, add explicit prompt: "How would you handle rebalancing when nodes are being drained during rolling upgrades?"
- For J. Osei, ask for a short Terraform example or a repo link if available.

Onboarding cohort week-2 pulse (raw):
- Quick survey sent to cohort (6 responses): 4 felt onboarding docs mostly adequate, 2 wanted clearer infra runbooks for local dev.
- Pain points: default local GPU images too big, bootstrapping Redis cluster for local tests flaky, credential scoping confusing for Private dev env.
- Wins: cohort hack day produced a prototype "local-kv-proxy" that reduces memory footprint by ~30% in dev, paired PR submitted (see linked PR).
- Notes to self: need a small checklist for local infra (credential rotation, sample data generator, memory/tuning tips).

Team health signals (incidents, capacity, morale):
- Incidents: one P2 last week (JDBC connection leak) — mitigated; postmortem in progress (JIRA-ENG-4998).
- Capacity: two senior ICs on PTO next week, coverage plan is half-baked. MUST finalize on-call swap by Friday.
- Morale: generally positive after hack day; a few devs expressed friction around async onboarding tasks (too many docs scattered).

Action items (owner, due):
- Create "local infra quickstart" single-page checklist and pin to the onboarding Confluence page (owner: Maya, due: 2025-10-17).
- Post take-home for K. Nguyen and send scoring template to interviewers (owner: Liam, due: 2025-10-21).
- Schedule 1:1 pairing for J. Osei with infra lead — 90m shadow session (owner: Ravi, target week of 10/20).
- Finish incident postmortem draft and share with SRE guild (owner: Dana, due: 2025-10-16).
- On-call swap confirm (owner: Aisha + SRE rotation), finalize by 2025-10-17.

Open questions / triage list:
- Do we formalize a 2-week "project" for new hires to give them ownership earlier? (pros: ownership, ramp; cons: noisy for customers). Need input from product.
- Should we add a short IaC checklist to the interview rubric for SRE candidates? (Ravi to propose minimal set).
- Is the local dev GPU image size acceptable or do we switch to a smaller base and pull heavy libs on demand? (R&D task: Maya + infra).

Meeting notes (this doc used in Fri sync 10/14):
- Quick round: each owner read their action items.
- Decision: we will run the take-home for K. Nguyen and reconvene 10/22 for final debrief.
- Decision: Maya will prototype a one-pager quickstart and ask cohort to pilot.

Misc fragments / notes to self:
- Remember to add "how to onboard to private deployment" checklist — customers sometimes ask for this during SSO audits.
- Link to sample runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/local-redis-setup (placeholder)
- Slack thread where cohort discussed proxy: slack://thread?channel=eng-platform&message=G9b2n4

Quick appendix (evidence):
- PR: github.com/redwoodinc/platform/pull/2110 — local-kv-proxy (cohort A)
- Jira: JIRA-ENG-4998 (postmortem), JIRA-ENG-4982 (onboarding checklist epic)

If anything missing or if you have notes from interviews that aren't captured here, drop them inline below or DM me on Slack. This will become the basis for the formal onboarding retro next week.

-- Aisha
